value.answer: Markets are shut today for Thanksgiving, so no trading on the TSX. Friday's last close was 35,664.62, up about 1.5% (519 points), helped by a surprise drop in jobs that cooled bets on a Bank of Canada rate hike. Trading resumes tomorrow at 9:30 a.m. ET.
